name: Diane Waldman

said.q: he reached his artistic maturity several years before his friends and colleagues of the future New York School, and introduced a complex set of ideas and problems he did not live to resolve.
said.in: “Arshile Gorky: Poet in Paint”, in Carol Fuerstein ed., Arshile Gorky: A Retrospective, exh. cat., Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, New York, 1981, p. 60

acts.t: Mark Rothko, 1930–1970: A Retrospective, exh. cat
acts.cite: Diane Waldman, Mark Rothko, 1930–1970: A Retrospective, exh. cat. (New York: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, 1978), no. 119, ill.

works: Study for Nighttime, Enigma and Nostalgia
